chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu Basir and Abu al-Abbas al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"If a man catches one rak'ah, he has caught the Friday prayer, and if it is missed by him, let him pray four (rak'ahs)."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one misses the Friday prayer or only catches one rak'ah with the Imam?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies that catching one rak'ah with the Imam constitutes full fulfillment of the Friday prayer obligation, distinguishing it from the four-rak'ah makeup required if the entire congregational prayer is missed. This ruling underscores the significance of the Imam's presence in completing the ritual, a key tenet in Usuli and Akhbari legal discussions regarding the validity of Jumu'ah in the absence of the Imam.
